text:
marta: kicking off a follow-up on Solstice LoRA onboarding. we hit a bunch of numeric mismatch false-negatives in the quick-eval. I'm opening this thread to track fixes and decisions.
jun: quick summary from my runs: fp16 baseline QA_F1=0.847, int8=0.839, int4=0.816. int8 latency improved ~18%, int4 ~33% vs fp16. main failure mode = numbers/currencies with commas and narrow token splits.
alex_r: thanks. I dug into tokenization diffs and saw the comma sometimes becomes a separate token in int4 outputs (token ids remap in decoding). looks like rounding in embedding table or a decoder-emission bias.
samira: I curated a small focused probe (40 examples) with currencies, dates, and comma-thousands. stored at /evals/solstice/num-probes-v2.json. running that as smoke now.
lia: idea: apply a post-eval normalizer that strips punctuation inside numeric groups for scoring only (e.g., "1,200.00 USD" -> "1200.00 USD") so we don't penalize minor tokenization differences. low-risk and quick.
jun: can we do both: normalizer for scoring + a lightweight postprocess on outputs for canary users? would avoid surprises in logs.
alex_r: +1. also want to add a token-id dump for failures so we can audit exact decode path. small change in eval harness to emit failing sample token ids to s3.
ci-bot: job 4623 queued: solstice int4 smoke on gpu-small-9. ETA 9m.
marta: decision proposal: int8 as default canary, int4 behind an experimental flag. add normalizer to evaluation scoring and add token-id logs for failing numeric probes. I volunteer to draft the rollout note.
samira: after normalizer patch (PR #1298) local smoke: fp16 F1=0.847, int8 F1=0.842 (probe fails 2/40), int4 F1=0.824 (probe fails 5/40). normalizer reduced false negatives by ~60%. attaching quick metric snippet: ```json
{"job":"4623","stage":"int8","metrics":{"qa_f1":0.842,"probe_fail":2}}
```
jun: pushed harness change to emit tokenids on failures: s3://redwood-debug/solstice/4623/fail-tokenids.log. also added regex normalizer: `re.sub(r"(?<=\d),(?=\d)", "", text)` in scoring pipeline.
lia: small UX ask: add a short note in release doc saying "numeric punctuation normalization applied to scoring only; model outputs are unchanged" so PMs and docs are clear.
alex_r: running token_diff tool for two failing samples; will paste results in the ticket. early findings: int4 decoders sometimes collapse comma+space into a single token which our exact_match check flags as mismatch.
marta: thanks all. plan: merge PRs, run canary int8 tonight, log int4 as shadow behind flag. publish rollback steps (pin to fp16) and add follow-up to investigate embedding rounding in quantized decoders. mark owners: jun -> quant testing and logs; alex_r -> tokenizer diffs; samira -> probe curation & metrics; lia -> release note.
jun: note for oncall: if canary shows >1% drop in exact_match on customer probes, rollback to fp16. I'll add CI alert.
ci-bot: deploy 4623 completed: int8 canary run finished, status: stable.
marta: closing loop — if no regressions in next 8h we promote int8 canary. leaving this thread open for token-diff artifacts. thanks team :raised_hands:
